in_game_description: A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its blue glimmer. Can be found between Aquila and Prospero.
mechanics_text: The best place to gather blue plasma is Wolf-Reiser because there are no enemies there.
917 tons are needed for the Chromo Plasma blueprint.
35 tons are needed for the Particle Shield blueprint.
30 tons are used by the Phoenix SIS to recharge shields.
